Provides three key capabilities for the observability module:

listitem.para: Rate calculation — tracks successive counter samples and computes the per-second rate of change, consistent with Prometheus rate().
Histogram aggregation — merges HistogramSnapshot objects (e.g. one per shard) and applies percentile, min/max/sum/avg reductions.

Rule-based aggregation — AggregationRule objects allow callers to declare how a named metric should be reduced, which labels to keep, and which high-cardinality labels to drop. applyRules() executes all registered rules against currently buffered snapshot data.

detaileddescription.para: Thread safety: all public methods are fully guarded by an internal mutex.
